name: alias_list
description: List aliases with optional state and text filters.

arguments.name: filter
arguments.desc: Return only aliases in this state. Mutually exclusive.

arguments.name: page_id
arguments.desc: Zero-based page number; 20 aliases per page. Defaults to 0.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Free-text search over alias email, note, and name.

name: alias_get
description: Get full details for one alias by id.

arguments.name: alias_id
arguments.desc: Numeric id of the alias to fetch.

name: alias_activity_list
description: List forward, reply, block, and bounce activity for one alias.

arguments.name: alias_id
arguments.desc: Numeric id of the alias whose activity to list.

arguments.name: page_id
arguments.desc: Zero-based page number; 20 entries per page. Defaults to 0.

name: alias_create_random
description: Create a random alias using uuid, word, or account-default style.

arguments.name: hostname
arguments.desc: Website hostname this alias is created for (context only).

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: Address style: "uuid" or "word". Defaults to the account setting.

arguments.name: note
arguments.desc: Optional note stored on the alias.

name: alias_create_custom
description: Create a custom alias from a prefix, signed suffix, and mailboxes.

arguments.name: alias_prefix
arguments.desc: The local part chosen by the user (text before the suffix).

arguments.name: mailbox_ids
arguments.desc: Ids of mailboxes that will own and receive mail for this alias.

arguments.name: signed_suffix
arguments.desc: A signed_suffix value returned verbatim by alias_options_get.

arguments.name: hostname
arguments.desc: Website hostname this alias is created for (context only).

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Optional display name for the alias.

arguments.name: note
arguments.desc: Optional note stored on the alias.

name: alias_update
description: Update alias note, name, mailboxes, PGP, or pinned state.

arguments.name: alias_id
arguments.desc: Numeric id of the alias to update.

arguments.name: disable_pgp
arguments.desc: Disable PGP on this alias even if a mailbox supports it.

arguments.name: mailbox_id
arguments.desc: Set a single owning mailbox by id, replacing current alias mailbox routing.

arguments.name: mailbox_ids
arguments.desc: Replace the full set of owning mailboxes by id.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Replace the alias display name.

arguments.name: note
arguments.desc: Replace the alias note.

arguments.name: pinned
arguments.desc: Pin or unpin the alias.

name: alias_delete
description: Permanently delete an alias after confirm=true.

arguments.name: alias_id
arguments.desc: Numeric id of the alias to delete.

arguments.name: confirm
arguments.desc: Must be set to true to confirm this permanent, irreversible deletion.

name: alias_set_enabled
description: Set an alias enabled or disabled without deleting it.

arguments.name: alias_id
arguments.desc: Numeric id of the alias to update.

arguments.name: enabled
arguments.desc: Desired state: true to enable the alias, false to disable it.

name: alias_options_get
description: Get custom-alias creation options and signed suffixes.

arguments.name: hostname
arguments.desc: Website hostname to tailor the prefix suggestion.

name: alias_domains_list
description: List domains usable for alias creation.

name: contact_list
description: List contacts and reverse aliases for one alias.

arguments.name: alias_id
arguments.desc: Numeric id of the alias whose contacts to list.

arguments.name: page_id
arguments.desc: Zero-based page number; 20 contacts per page. Defaults to 0.

name: contact_create
description: Create or reuse a reverse alias for a recipient.

arguments.name: alias_id
arguments.desc: Numeric id of the alias to create the contact on.

arguments.name: contact
arguments.desc: Recipient address, optionally with a display name: "Name <addr@example.com>".

name: contact_set_blocked
description: Set whether forwarding from a contact is blocked.

arguments.name: alias_id
arguments.desc: Numeric id of the alias the contact belongs to.

arguments.name: blocked
arguments.desc: Desired state: true to block forwarding from the contact, false to allow it.

arguments.name: contact_id
arguments.desc: Numeric id of the contact to block or unblock.

name: contact_delete
description: Permanently delete a contact after confirm=true.

arguments.name: confirm
arguments.desc: Must be set to true to confirm this permanent, irreversible deletion.

arguments.name: contact_id
arguments.desc: Numeric id of the contact to delete.

name: mailbox_list
description: List account mailboxes and verification/default state.

name: mailbox_create
description: Add a mailbox and send its verification email.

arguments.name: email
arguments.desc: Address of the new mailbox; it receives the verification email.

name: mailbox_update
description: Set a default mailbox, start an email change, or cancel one.

arguments.name: mailbox_id
arguments.desc: Numeric id of the mailbox to update.

arguments.name: cancel_email_change
arguments.desc: Cancel a pending email change on this mailbox.

arguments.name: email
arguments.desc: New address for the mailbox; the change is pending until verified.

arguments.name: set_default
arguments.desc: Make this mailbox the account default. The mailbox must be verified.

name: mailbox_delete
description: Permanently delete a mailbox after explicit alias handling.

arguments.name: confirm
arguments.desc: Must be set to true to confirm this permanent, irreversible deletion.

arguments.name: mailbox_id
arguments.desc: Numeric id of the mailbox to delete.

arguments.name: delete_aliases
arguments.desc: Explicitly acknowledge that the owned aliases are deleted with the mailbox.

arguments.name: transfer_aliases_to
arguments.desc: Id of a different verified mailbox that takes over the owned aliases.

name: custom_domain_list
description: List custom domains and their settings.

name: custom_domain_update
description: Update supported custom-domain routing and display settings.

arguments.name: custom_domain_id
arguments.desc: Numeric id of the custom domain to update.

arguments.name: catch_all
arguments.desc: Auto-create an alias when mail arrives for an unknown address on the domain; false disables that catch-all routing.

arguments.name: mailbox_ids
arguments.desc: Replace the full set of mailboxes that receive the domain's mail, by id.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Display name used as the From name for the domain's aliases; null clears it.

arguments.name: random_prefix_generation
arguments.desc: Use a random prefix instead of the address when auto-creating aliases.

name: custom_domain_trash_list
description: List deleted aliases remembered for one custom domain.

arguments.name: custom_domain_id
arguments.desc: Numeric id of the custom domain whose trash to list.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum deleted aliases to return; defaults to 100.

arguments.name: page_id
arguments.desc: Zero-based page number; defaults to 0.

name: account_get_info
description: Get user info and validate the configured API key.

name: account_get_stats
description: Get lifetime account counters.

name: notification_list
description: List account notifications unread first.

arguments.name: page_id
arguments.desc: Zero-based page number; 20 notifications per page. Defaults to 0.

name: notification_mark_read
description: Mark one notification as read.

arguments.name: notification_id
arguments.desc: Numeric id of the notification to mark as read.

name: settings_get
description: Get account-wide alias settings.

name: settings_update
description: Update supported account-wide alias settings.

arguments.name: alias_generator
arguments.desc: Address style for random aliases: "word" (word-based) or "uuid".

arguments.name: notification
arguments.desc: Whether SimpleLogin sends the user email notifications.

arguments.name: random_alias_default_domain
arguments.desc: Domain used for random aliases; one of the domains from alias_domains_list.

arguments.name: random_alias_suffix
arguments.desc: Suffix style for random and on-the-fly aliases: "word" (dictionary word) or "random_string".

arguments.name: sender_format
arguments.desc: How the original sender appears in forwarded mail. For john@wick.com ("John Wick"): AT = "John Wick - john at wick.com", A = "John Wick - john(a)wick.com", NAME_ONLY = "John Wick", AT_ONLY = "john at wick.com", NO_NAME = no sender shown.
